임차인
임차인은 임대차 계약에 따라 주택을 사용하는 자로, 시설 하자 발생 시 임대인에게 손해배상을 청구할 수 있다.

배수관
배수관은 주택에서 물이 흘러들어가는 경로로, 막힐 경우 역류 현상이 발생할 수 있다.

손해배상
손해배상은 임대인이 하자 수리를 이행하지 않아 발생한 임차인의 손해에 대해 보상하는 법적 권리이다.

주택_및_부동산
주택_및_부동산은 임대차 계약과 관련된 주제 영역으로, 시설 하자 및 보수 문제를 포함한다.

임대인
임대인은 임대차 계약에서 주택의 소유자이며, 수리 및 청소 비용에 대한 의무를 지닌다.

하자
하자는 주택의 시설이 정상적으로 작동하지 않거나 문제가 생긴 상태를 의미한다.

싱크대
싱크대는 주택 내에서 수세미로 사용하는 설비로, 배수관과 연결되어 있다.

수선의무
수선의무는 임대인이 임차인이 정상적으로 사용하도록 주택의 하자를 수리할 책임을 지닌다는 법적 의무이다.

길고양이 중성화 사업
길고양이 중성화 사업 is a project aimed at controlling the stray cat population humanely and reducing citizen inconvenience.

길고양이
길고양이 refers to stray cats that are the focus of the 길고양이 중성화 사업.

임대차_시설_하자_보수
임대차_시설_하자_보수는 임대차 계약 하에 발생한 시설의 하자 및 그 수리와 관련된 주제다.

서울시
서울시 is the city in South Korea where the 길고양이 중성화 사업 is being implemented.<SEP>서울시는 코로나19로 인해 경영에 어려움을 겪는 소상공인을 위해 다양한 금융 지원 사업을 운영하는 기관이다.<SEP>서울시는 한국의 수도로, 수도요금과 관련된 정책을 시행하는 주체이다.<SEP>서울시 is the capital city of South Korea, located in the northwest part of the country.<SEP>서울시 is the capital city of South Korea where the 다산콜센터 is located and operates.<SEP>서울시 is the capital city of South Korea, where the rental properties eligible for the loans must be located.

TNR
TNR (Trap-Neuter-Return) is the method used in the 길고양이 중성화 사업 to control the stray cat population.<SEP>TNR stands for Trap-Neuter-Return, a method for managing stray cat populations humanely.

시민 불편
시민 불편 represents the inconveniences faced by citizens due to stray cats, which the project aims to alleviate.

진공 효과
진공 효과 (Vacuum Effect) is a phenomenon where the elimination of stray cats leads to new cats entering the territory.

구청
구청 refers to the district offices that oversee the implementation of the 길고양이 중성화 사업.<SEP>The 구청 is a branch of local government similar to 시청, involved in the administration of various programs including the 긴급복지 생계지원금.

관할 등기소
관할 등기소 (Registry Office) is the official office where 법인 등기부등본 can be requested either in person or online.

중성화 수술
중성화 수술 (Neuter Surgery) is the surgical procedure performed on stray cats as part of the TNR method.

정부24
정부24 is a government website that allows online access to various administrative services including the issuance of 법인 등기부등본.<SEP>정부24 is an online platform that facilitates access to various government services, including the issuance of 법인 등기부등본.

가대구광역시
대구광역시는 대한민국의 도시로, 코로나19로 어려움을 겪는 시민을 위해 긴급재난생활지원금을 시행하였다.

귀 표시 방법
귀 표시 방법 is the method used to identify neutered stray cats by cutting part of their ear.

법인 등기부등본
법인 등기부등본 is a public document that certifies the identity and status of a corporation.<SEP>법인 등기부등본 refers to the corporate registration document that can be obtained by individuals or organizations for verification or legal purposes.

인터넷등기소
인터넷등기소 is an online platform where 법인 등기부등본 can be issued using a digital certificate.<SEP>인터넷등기소 (Internet Registry Office) is an online registry service where 법인 등기부등본 can be issued using an official certificate.

신고 절차
신고 절차 refers to the process of reporting stray cats that may require neutering.

실직자
실직자는 일자리를 잃은 개인으로, 긴급재난생활지원금의 주요 지원 대상이다.

긴급재난생활지원금
긴급재난생활지원금은 코로나19로 인해 경제적 어려움을 겪는 시민들에게 제공되는 재정 지원금이다.

일용직 근로자
일용직 근로자는 임시로 고용된 노동자로, 긴급재난생활지원금의 지원 대상에 포함된다.

50만 원에서 100만 원
50만 원에서 100만 원 사이의 금액이 긴급재난생활지원금의 지원 범위를 나타낸다.

A차 재난지원금
A차 재난지원금 is a selective disaster relief fund aimed at providing financial support to those affected by the COVID-19 pandemic in South Korea.<SEP>A차 재난지원금 refers to a specific type of disaster relief fund being distributed as part of government support measures.

시청 공식 홈페이지
대구광역시청의 공식 홈페이지는 최신 공고 및 정보를 제공하는 중요한 출처이다.

대구광역시청
대구광역시청은 대구광역시 정부의 행정기관으로, 긴급재난생활지원금에 대한 공고를 관리한다.

특수형태 근로종사자
특수형태 근로종사자 refers to individuals in non-standard employment situations who are eligible for the 긴급고용안정지원금.

다산콜센터
다산콜센터, also known as Dasan Call Center, is an organization that operates as a comprehensive support and consultation center addressing public inquiries. It specifically provides assistance regarding disaster relief funds, including relevant information on financial support related to events such as the COVID-19 pandemic. The center serves as a vital point of contact for various welfare-related queries and public service supports, which encompass areas like public transportation schedules.

In addition to its role in supporting disaster-related inquiries, 다산콜센터 is responsible for receiving and processing civil complaints, thereby facilitating communication between residents and relevant authorities. It is equipped to handle a range of issues, providing guidance for residents facing maintenance problems, particularly in situations lacking a designated management authority. The center allows customers to apply for financial settlements and offers references for specific support cases, ensuring that residents have access to the necessary information and assistance for their needs.

Through its diverse range of services, 다산콜센터 aims to enhance public access to support systems and streamline the consultation process for citizens facing various challenges.<SEP>The 다산콜센터 (Dasan Call Center) provides support and information regarding public services in Seoul.<SEP>다산콜센터 is a call center serving as a contact point for administrative inquiries related to the city of Seoul.<SEP>다산콜센터 is a service center providing consultation and support, referenced in the extracted text.

소상공인
소상공인 refers to small businesses that can claim the A차 재난지원금 if they are impacted by administrative orders.<SEP>소상공인은 코로나19로 인해 피해를 입은 기업으로, 서울시의 금융 지원 사업의 대상이다.<SEP>소상공인 refers to small business owners in South Korea, particularly those impacted by economic difficulties due to the COVID-19 pandemic.<SEP>소상공인은 코로나19로 인해 경영상 어려움을 겪고 있는 소규모 사업자를 지칭합니다.

저소득층
저소득층 encompasses low-income groups qualifying for the A차 재난지원금, including traditional welfare beneficiaries.<SEP>저소득층 refers to individuals with low income, who may benefit from programs like the 경기도 일하는 청년 통장 for financial assistance.

고용취약계층
고용취약계층 includes individuals in unstable employment who can apply for certain types of disaster relief.

자영업자
자영업자 represents self-employed individuals who may receive assistance through the A차 재난지원금 due to business restrictions.

긴급고용안정지원금
긴급고용안정지원금 is a specific support program designed to assist special types of workers and freelancers during economic hardships.<SEP>긴급고용안정지원금 refers to a specific emergency employment stability support fund provided by the government to assist individuals facing unemployment during the pandemic.

서울시 복지포털
서울시 복지포털 is an online portal providing information about welfare programs, including future announcements related to the A차 재난지원금.

등기소
등기소 is a local office where legal documents like 법인 등기부등본 can be issued.

각 구청 홈페이지
각 구청 홈페이지 refers to the official websites of district offices where related announcements about the A차 재난지원금 will be published.

무인민원발급기
무인민원발급기 is a self-service machine that can issue 법인 등기부등본 quickly.

공인인증서
공인인증서 is a digital certificate required for identity verification when applying for 법인 등기부등본 online.

법인 등기사항전부증명서
법인 등기사항전부증명서 is a complete certificate that documents all registered details about a corporation.

발급 수수료
발급 수수료 refers to the fees associated with issuing 법인 등기부등본, such as the costs for both in-person and online requests.

서울특별시
서울특별시 is the capital city of South Korea, where 광진구 is located.<SEP>서울특별시는 서울시청이 소속된 지역으로, 고용유지지원금의 지원 대상 지역이다.

5인 미만 소상공인 사업주
5인 미만 소상공인 사업주 refers to small business owners in 광진구 with less than five employees who are eligible for the financial assistance.

광진형 소상공인 고용유지지원금
The 광진형 소상공인 고용유지지원금 is a financial assistance program intended to support small business owners in 광진구 affected by COVID-19 by providing direct monetary support for a limited duration.

미취업 청년
미취업 청년 refers to unemployed youth facing difficulties in job searching due to the COVID-19 crisis.

코로나19
코로나19, also known as COVID-19, is a viral infection that has resulted in a global pandemic, significantly affecting public health and prompting extensive measures regarding social distancing, travel restrictions, and various government interventions. The outbreak has led governments worldwide to implement support programs aimed at assisting individuals who have been impacted, such as workers needing unpaid leave for caregiving responsibilities.

In particular, 코로나19 has had notable repercussions for small businesses, especially in areas like 광진구, where financial assistance has been necessary to mitigate the economic strain resulting from the pandemic. The widespread nature of the virus has not only caused health concerns but has also led to substantial economic challenges across multiple sectors, including industries such as forestry. 

The pandemic has prompted public inquiries about effective treatment and prevention, highlighting the urgent need for coordinated health responses. Overall, 코로나19 signifies a critical public health crisis with far-reaching impacts on economy and society, necessitating comprehensive policy responses to address both immediate and long-term consequences.

광진구
광진구 is a district in Seoul, South Korea, which is the administrative area for the 지원금 program.

손 소독제
손 소독제 refers to hand sanitizers which are necessary for maintaining good hand hygiene as part of the 방역 수칙.

마스크
마스크 are face masks that should be worn in enclosed spaces and where maintaining a distance of 2m is difficult.<SEP>마스크 is a face covering that students and staff must wear at all times indoors in the school.

손 씻기
손 씻기 refers to the method of washing hands for at least 30 seconds with running water and soap as part of the 방역 수칙.

Water Meter
Water Meter is the device used to measure water consumption, central to the inquiry about excess charges.<SEP>The Water Meter is a device used to measure water consumption, with a dial indicator referred to as a star-pointer (별침) used for leak detection.<SEP>The water meter is a device that measures water usage and is integral to assessing potential leaks in plumbing systems.<SEP>The Water Meter is used to measure the quantity of water consumed and is subject to performance testing if discrepancies are suspected.<SEP>Water Meter is a device used to measure the volume of water consumed by a household or unit.

Bathroom
The Bathroom is a potential leak-checking area where sounds of running water from the toilet tank should be monitored.

Leak Detection
Leak Detection is a process to identify water leaks either large or small, indicated by the movement of the star-pointer on the water meter.<SEP>Leak Detection is the process of identifying leaks in plumbing systems to ascertain the cause of high water bills.

부가가치세과세표준증명서
부가가치세과세표준증명서 is a tax document required for verifying revenue decrease for business owners applying for the 지원금.

Boiler Room
Boiler Room is a part of the building where heating is managed, also suggested as an area to check for leaks.<SEP>The Boiler Room is a location where connections to the boiler and washing machine faucets should be inspected for leaks.

Kitchen
The Kitchen is another area where checking for leaks should involve inspecting under the sink and around the water heater.

Water Meter Reading
The Water Meter Reading is the recorded measurement of water usage over a specific period, critical for billing and leak detection.

Leak Repair Company
A Leak Repair Company is a specialized service provider that can be found via internet searches for leak detection services.

Water Bill
The Water Bill reflects the charges for water usage, which in this context is reported as excessively high at 900,000 won.<SEP>The Water Bill refers to the statement of charges for water usage, which may be affected by leaks or other issues.<SEP>The Water Bill contains details about charges for water supply and drainage services, and includes the Customer Number.

Detection Company
Detection Company is a specialized service that helps locate leaks within a building's water system.

Leakage
Leakage refers to the loss of water due to leaks within pipes, which is suspected as the cause for the high water bill.<SEP>Leakage refers to the unintended escape of water from plumbing fixtures, requiring diagnostic and repair intervention.

Municipal Water Authority
The Municipal Water Authority is the local governing body responsible for water supply management and regulation in a specific area.

Goshiwon
Goshiwon is a type of low-cost rent accommodation, which is mentioned in relation to water usage inquiries.<SEP>Goshiwon is a type of small, budget accommodation that is also classified as a non-residential property for tax purposes.

Sink
Sink refers to a household fixture where water is used, mentioned as a potential source to check for leaks.<SEP>The sink is an element in the kitchen where the white stains have been observed, potentially caused by minerals in the tap water.

Water Bill Discount Application
The Water Bill Discount Application is a process for residents to request a reduction in their water bill due to indoor leaks after repairs.

여행
여행 is the act of traveling, which has been impacted by COVID-19 guidelines and recommendations on mobility.

Building Inspection
Building Inspection refers to the process of examining the building for potential sources of leakage and related issues guided by the inquiry.

추석
추석 is a major harvest festival in Korean culture, marked by family gatherings and traditional customs.

이동 자제
이동 자제 refers to the recommendation encouraging individuals to avoid unnecessary travel during the pandemic.

12월
12월 indicates the month in which the A차 재난지원금 is planned to be distributed, subject to finalization of the evaluation process.

Dasan Call Center
The Dasan Call Center is a comprehensive service in Seoul dedicated to addressing a variety of citizen inquiries, particularly those related to water issues. It serves as a primary contact point for residents to apply for leak detection services, seek assistance with water bills, and obtain information regarding water-related benefits. 

In addition to water services, the Dasan Call Center also provides support with inquiries related to property taxes and other public concerns, showcasing its role as a multifaceted governmental resource. The center is particularly valued for its consulting capabilities, often referenced in inquiry case studies to illustrate effective citizen support mechanisms. 

Moreover, the Dasan Call Center has adapted its services to current public health needs by offering consultations pertaining to COVID-19 guidelines. This versatility further emphasizes its importance as a resource for the community. Additionally, the center facilitates applications for free water quality tests and offers assistance with complaints related to water quality and pipe issues, thereby ensuring residents have access to vital information and services that impact their daily lives.<SEP>Dasan Call Center is an organization associated with public inquiries and tax concerns, referenced in the source dialogue regarding reasan tax.<SEP>Dasan Call Center is a customer service center that assists individuals with inquiries related to water service and billing, such as moving procedures.

방역 지침
방역 지침 includes the set of rules and recommendations to help prevent the spread of COVID-19.

기준중위소득
기준중위소득 (median income standard) refers to a benchmark used to determine the income eligibility for the 청년저축계좌 program.

청년저축계좌
The 청년저축계좌 (Youth Savings Account) is a savings program designed to help working youth accumulate funds to support their financial independence and stability.

B24034
B24034 is a document ID related to COVID-19 consultation regarding loan support for low-credit individuals.

소득인정액
소득인정액 (recognized income) is a measure that combines an individual's income and assets to assess eligibility for the 청년저축계좌 program.

행정복지센터
행정복지센터 (Administrative Welfare Center) is the government agency where individuals can apply for the 청년저축계좌 and verify their eligibility based on income.<SEP>The 행정복지센터 is an administrative center for welfare services, including the application process for the 긴급복지 생계지원금.

2020년
2020년 (year 2020) marks the year when the 청년저축계좌 program was first implemented.

사회적 거리두기
사회적 거리두기 refers to measures implemented to reduce the spread of COVID-19 by encouraging people to maintain physical distance.<SEP>사회적 거리두기 is the practice of maintaining physical distance between individuals to reduce the spread of COVID-19.

1,080만원
1,080만원 (10,800,000 KRW) is the maximum amount a participant can receive upon maturity of the 청년저축계좌.

Low-Credit Individual
Low-Credit Individual refers to persons with poor credit ratings who may seek financial support.

Small Business
Small Business refers to businesses with limited revenue and employee numbers that can apply for specific financial aids.

Emergency Loan
The Emergency Loan is a financial aid program with a maximum limit of 10 million won, aimed at stabilizing the management of low-credit small business owners.

Youth-Owned Business
Youth-Owned Business refers to enterprises run by younger individuals, eligible for emergency loan support.

NCB Personal Credit Assessment
The NCB Personal Credit Assessment is a rating system used to evaluate the credit ratings of individuals, which is a criterion for loan eligibility.

Disabled-Owned Business
Disabled-Owned Business refers to enterprises operated by individuals with disabilities, eligible for emergency loan support.

Women-Owned Business
Women-Owned Business represents businesses run by women, qualifying for emergency loan support.

B22203
B22203 is a document ID related to administrative inquiries concerning stray cat neutering programs.

Stray Cat Neutering Program
The Stray Cat Neutering Program refers to a city initiative (TNR) aimed at controlling stray cat populations by neutering.

Seoul
Seoul is a city in South Korea that serves as its capital. It is notable for addressing various social and infrastructure issues, including the discussions around loan support where individual low-credit loan options are reportedly missing. The city has been proactive in managing water supply concerns, with authorities implementing measures to tackle water supply issues and offering water fee reduction benefits to its residents. The management of the water supply termination process is also handled by the water supply office in Seoul, indicating a structured approach to addressing water service continuity.

In the context of public health and safety, Seoul has implemented Social Distancing Level 2 measures, particularly aimed at controlling public gatherings, reflecting its commitment to managing health crises. Additionally, Seoul is recognized for its cultural vibrancy, hosting numerous cultural events and providing various facilities that enhance its status as a cultural hub. The city's drinking water, known as Arisu tap water, is supplied and undergoes regular quality testing, which underscores the importance of ensuring safe and reliable water resources for its inhabitants. Overall, Seoul exemplifies a dynamic urban environment that balances social welfare, public health, and cultural enrichment.<SEP>Seoul is the capital city of South Korea, where Guro-gu is located and the Guro G Festival is held.

Financial Support Information
Financial Support Information refers to the relevant information regarding loans and financial assistance for low-credit individuals discussed in the documents.

District Office
District Office refers to local government offices responsible for managing initiatives like the stray cat neutering program.

Seoul City 120 Dasan Call Center
The Seoul City 120 Dasan Call Center is a resource for individuals seeking financial support information in Seoul.

대구광역시
대구광역시는 코로나19로 인한 경제적 어려움을 해결하기 위해 긴급재난생활지원금을 제공하였다.

손 위생
손 위생 practices include the use of 손 소독제 to minimize the risk of spreading infections.

긴급복지 생계지원금
The 긴급복지 생계지원금 is a government support program aimed at assisting low-income households facing sudden crises to maintain their livelihoods.

보건복지부
The 보건복지부 (Ministry of Health and Welfare) is responsible for establishing and announcing the criteria for support in South Korea.<SEP>The 보건복지부 is the government ministry responsible for overseeing the 긴급복지 생계지원금 and other welfare programs.

서산시
서산시 is a city where residents can apply for the 긴급복지 생계지원금.

읍면동 주민센터
The 읍면동 주민센터 is a local administrative center where residents can apply for the 긴급복지 생계지원금.

시청
The 시청 is the local government office where applications for the 긴급복지 생계지원금 may be submitted.

복지로 웹사이트
The 복지로 웹사이트 is a resource for checking available welfare support programs.

기준 중위소득
The 기준 중위소득 (Median Income Standard) is the income threshold for support eligibility, set at 75% of the median income.<SEP>기준 중위소득 refers to the median income level used to determine eligibility for government support programs, including the 긴급복지 생계지원금.

Water Supply Office
The Water Supply Office handles queries and inspections related to water leakage issues but does not perform repairs directly.<SEP>The Water Supply Office is the governing body responsible for managing water supply issues and handling water meter performance tests.<SEP>The Water Supply Office handles the applications for water supply termination and oversees the necessary procedures.
